about: Slides for the recorded walkthrough, opened with Present (Shift+P) in the docs site. English only. Sections and numbers match the case in the sidebar (0 · Overview to 6 · What I'll test next). Each slide has a section, a theme (indigo, lavender, butter, peach, pistachio, paper, night) and a layout (cover, section, points, statement, stats, rows, close). Media paths are repo-relative. Every number here is checked against docs/case/*.md.

slides.title: Snuffle
lines: Bring a high street's small shops into one app, and take a position on findability or the transaction
Built alone with AI agents, 1–6 November 2026
